data.body: RP-05 routing-order decision approved (2026-08-18): overview, canonical top-level help, accepted-alias help, and unknown-command rendering are pre-operation routing. The CLI parses only enough global syntax to identify the route and reject structurally malformed global syntax; those paths do not compose the RP-04 operation snapshot, discover/materialize config, mount a store, resolve a handler, import optional packages, or check capabilities. Real execution crosses the operation-snapshot/config boundary afterward. Nested help remains owned by the selected handler and must be side-effect-free/lean-tested; the top-level registry does not duplicate nested argument parsing. Baseline refreshed immediately afterward: clean planning worktree HEAD == origin/main == 3b34d8b449ae4b56a5da8fb434aa75df7194b0c4, which contains the currently landed RP-04 work.
